# U023 — Conversion factor for `'INCH'` is wrong / omitted

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

**Section**: §12.5 (`12-5-units`)  
**Fixture**: [`step-examples/12-5-units/U023.stp`](../../step-examples/12-5-units/U023.stp)  

## Sources
- 02-caxif.md "Conversion-based unit value mismatch" (UDA v1.8 Annex C, §7.3)

## Description

A `CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT('INCH',...)` must reference a `LENGTH_MEASURE_WITH_UNIT(LENGTH_MEASURE(25.4), <millimeter>)`. Writers that emit a wrong factor (e.g. `2.54E1` against a model whose values are mm; or `25.4` against a metre-based reference) or omit the conversion entirely break unit interpretation.

## Reproducer recipe

`LENGTH_MEASURE_WITH_UNIT(LENGTH_MEASURE(2.54E1), #mm); CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT('INCH', #lmwu)` paired with a model whose values are actually in mm.

## Expected kernel behavior

verify conversion-based-unit factors against known SI conversions; reject / warn if `name` and numeric factor are inconsistent.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject`
